method: Unity URP PreviewRenderUtility. Source FBX mesh instances only, isolated in a temporary preview scene. Curated visibility and, where recorded, translated components; no vertex, normal, boundary or source material changes.
interpretation: Healthy anatomical subject previews, not diagnostic images or representations of disease severity. Teal is interface emphasis. Exploded assembly views are presentation only. No labels or physiological claims are baked into the pixels.
attribution: BodyParts3D / The Database Center for Life Science (CC BY 4.0), Medical Augmented Learning source lung models, and existing authored teaching reconstructions. Exact source kinds and source records are recorded for every depicted component; anatomy-catalog.json remains authoritative.
runtime: 16 static 512 x 320 textures; mipmaps; trilinear filtering; BC7 on Windows, ASTC 6x6 on Android. No runtime render textures, live cameras, or anatomical colliders are added.
